reward: native terminal outcome plus Phi(next)-Phi(now); gamma=1; terminal potential zero, full return equals native outcome minus starting potential
training_clock: frozen; independent confirmation uses native wall clock
qualification_rule: Frozen candidate on disjoint seeds versus default briefing and autonomous Crew6. At least 3 more wins than default; at least autonomous wins; no avoidable immediate losses or truncations. No tuning on confirmation outcomes.
exploration: one sampled goal in one round, 80% alternative mixture with exact recorded behavior likelihood and importance weights; all deterministic actions critic-only
actor_advantage: paired one-round TD difference plus 2 times paired terminal win difference
